messages.author: 0ba879ee484dc0b6
messages.subject: Typo in stan-reference
parts:
I hope this is the right place to post regarding the documentation. A github issue seemed wrong for this purpose.

Stan reference version 2.9.0 (most recent on mc-stan.org) has a typo on page 41 under the header "5. Multiple and Range Indexing" :

Stan allows multiple indexes to be provided for containers (i.e., arrays, vectors,
and matrices) in a single position, using either an array of integer indexes or range bounds. 
This allows hierarchical 1

Then it just goes to a subheader. I thought this bit might be incomplete and wanted to pass this along so it doesn't go under the radar
